# Running the example notebooks

A number of examples to showcase the main functionalities of turbocluster are provided in the `examples/` directory. It is recommended to start with those to get familiar with the code.

To execute the notebooks it is recommended to install `jupyter` in your conda environment:
- `conda activate [name of the environment]`
- `conda install jupyter`

The jupyter server can then be started by typing in the terminal: `jupyter notebook`
